relevance.rationale: BROKEN SOURCE JOIN: the named file does not exist, so no citation-support check against the text was possible. The citation is clearly load-bearing where it appears: mass-theory/hecke-markov-transition-proof.md:19 asserts that the systematic-scan Metropolis algorithm on S_n targeting the Mallows measure pi(sigma) proportional to q^inv(sigma) has transition operator K = K_1 K_2 ... K_{n-1}, a product of Hecke algebra elements, and attributes it wholesale to this reference — i.e. step (ii) of the proof is discharged by citation, not by argument. Seven further sites in mass-theory/hecke-markov-transition.lean (lines 27, 46, 87, 111, 182, 224, 257, 269). VENUE CONTRADICTION INSIDE THE CORPUS: folio/schema/references.ts records one journal for this id while all seven Lean '-- Ref:' strings name a different journal (both strings are given in the triage summary). Those are different periodicals; at most one is right, and a reader following either pointer may not land on the work that supports the proof step.

proposedActions.rationale: A proof step discharged purely by citation should point at a venue the corpus agrees on. Record and resolve the contradiction between the registered entry and the seven Lean Ref strings.
